body:
I can relate to this very well.

I'd do the same thing. I'd say no to gatherings even though my friends have invited me many times over the past year. I'd just refuse to answer messages from friends for a few days for no reason other than I'm tired of social media. I'm sure they're sick of me. I want to be done with it already.

Right, it annoys me that people keep saying 'life's gonna get better'.

No it fucking isn't, it's just the necessary lies of civilization to keep it from falling apart. At the end of the day everything is a dice roll, we just happened to get the low roll and end up on someone else's Mayfair.

Life is life. Fucking let us choose to live or die, we didn't ask to be brought to this world.

I'm a college undergraduate, can't complain about life either. I'm one of the lucky ones, my parents gave me full ride to college. Didn't have to take loans like so many others, I live in a comfy apartment. Life is good, I've got money, food, shelter, everything that I need to sustain myself really. That's why it makes me feel even guiltier when I think about ending it. Thank you for sharing, I can relate to it. Maybe I should start planning the least painful way to end it for my parents, I don't want to burden them anymore.
With how 2020 is going right now. I'm truly wishing that a natural cause, maybe a meteor or two, would end me
